Story.Hello: Hello, dear friend. Commander Vesna of the Druzhna . The pleasure is all mine. The gun salute and honor guard are in position and ready for your grand welcome. Of course, if you're not one for fanfare, I've also arranged a more private welcome ceremony. Come on, this way~
Story.Chat: Service: The Druzhna takes orders only from the Tsaritsa , so they cannot be at your beck and call. But Vesna the Vila is happy to be of service, my dear friend.
Story.Chat: Happiness: Isn't this outfit just gorgeous? It was a personal gift from Her Majesty. Hehe, that's right, feast your eyes.
Story.Chat: Efficiency: What paperwork? Oh, I finished it ages ago — flew through it. Now it's time to get out on patrol. C'mon, let's go~
Story.When It Rains: Fae can absolutely catch colds. When they get wet, it's important to flap them dry right away. T—The wings, I mean.
Story.When It Snows: In the snow, the slightest imperfection in your camouflage can be fatal. So tread carefully, dear friend.
Story.When the Sun Is Out: I know what you're thinking — and I agree. My wings look their most dazzling in the sun.
Story.When It's Windy: Ah... Hehe, very nice. The Vila just love a good breeze.
Story.In the Desert: Just wondering... When are we heading back to Snezhnaya again?
Story.Good Morning: A new day! Good morning, Snezhnograd !
Story.Good Afternoon: Off we go to Podvorye Restaurant , come on! My treat, of course. As always!
Story.Good Evening: The Korolevskiy Troupe is debuting a new show tonight. Featuring Prima Donna Vodyanitsa 's high soprano, Miss Odette latest choreography... and a few "new friends."
Story.Good Night: Pssst... You can't be asleep already. Come out for a late-night walk? The aurora is great tonight!
Story.About Vesna: Magic Weapon: See these little things flying around me? They're my magic weapons, my own creations. Each one is a blend of elemental energy and my own will, so they've inherited something of my personality as well. Which is to say, it's possible that they might pester you to play with them. Don't mind them... Though of course, if you have time, please indulge them, hehe!
Story.About Vesna: Commander: Who says a commander needs to be strict and imposing? Pshh, that's for people with no presence. I don't need it~ I think we're quite similar in that regard.
Story.About Us: The Truth: I get it, I get it. There are all sorts of rumors flying around about me, and you want to know the truth. Well, that's fine, we have plenty of time for that. But in return, I want to know the truth about you, too, down to the very last detail.
Story.About Us: Company: I don't like the idea of "accompanying" someone on a journey. It sounds romantic at first, but when you think about it, the word "accompany" makes one person the protagonist and the other a mere sidekick. The truth is, every step we take is our own, as are the things we experience and the ways we grow along the way. So, I won't say that I'm "accompanying" you on your journey — rather that I'm glad to have the pleasure of your company on what happens to be, for now, a shared journey. Think of it like this... you're walking along, minding your own business, then at some point you turn your head and notice: Oh wow! Haha, look at that — seems like we're both going the same way!
Story.About the Stellar Linchpin: Stellar Linchpins are beautifully designed. Absolutely a collector's item. Actually, Moon Wheels aren't bad, either. Always wanted to get my hands on one. As for Visions , though... Not interested at the moment, sorry.
Story.Something to Share: Oh, you mean this old thing? Beautiful, isn't it? It's a family heirloom, you know. Much, much older than I am. A true antique, in fact, worthy of a museum. Sometimes I use it as a magic wand, sometimes as a pointer when giving a class, and sometimes as a commander's baton... Ah, just look at me, giving it the chance to relive its glory days at this ripe old age, rather than locking it up in a bank vault somewhere to gather dust. My ancestors would be lining up to sing my praises if they knew!
Story.Interesting Things: The Frostfairy Flower is a thing of beauty and resilience, surviving in spite of the brutally cold environment. It also has a very distinctive pattern. I like gazing at it through half-closed eyes as I shake my head, hehe — it creates a dreamy effect, like looking through a kaleidoscope. That said, I'd advise doing that in a private place with no one else around.
Story.About the Tsaritsa: Loyalty: I've apprehended far too many self-righteous fools who wish to oppose Her Majesty. Their grand speeches about conquest? All show and no substance. They have neither the strategy to launch a rebellion nor the competence to see it through. Compared to those would-be revolutionaries... No, I take that back. They don't even deserve to be mentioned in the same breath as Her Majesty. My point is, serving the Tsaritsa is not only my duty as a Vila. It's also my personal choice as Vesna.
Story.About the Tsaritsa: Compassion: Her Majesty always speaks the word "compassion" with an icy sting to it. She says it's a curse imposed upon the gods by the Heavenly Principles , not genuine love. But I very much disagree. Whenever I return from a campaign against monsters, Her Majesty adds "rest well" at the end of her personal decree. And after the Ruler of Life's power was reclaimed, she sensed how disappointed I was, despite my efforts to hide it, and sent the unclaimed portion back to me... Someone in her position has no obligation to do any of these things. At the risk of sounding presumptuous, I've always believed that the question of whether a god is truly loving can only be answered by their people. So why shouldn't my verdict count?
Story.About Danica : Childhood: Oh, dearest Miss Danica... Don't be fooled by her serious and brooding demeanor. We got up to all kinds of mischief together when we were little... Like the time we plotted to steal Teacher's mask right off of his face. We made it all the way up onto his shoulders before getting caught! Sure, we didn't quite pull it off, and yes, we got punished — had to stand at attention on a frozen lake for hours... Ah, but anyway, that's besides the point! She was the one who came up with that crazy idea in the first place! She was every bit the troublemaker I was. And now she gives me that look all the time, like she's the adult and I'm the child. I mean, puh-lease. I'm actually the older one.
Story.About Danica: Arguments: We have good intel that certain suspects are using bizarre events like "Quarreling Contests" as a front to conduct illegal business transactions, the rowdy crowd serving as a handy distraction... And so, it falls to me to intervene. To that end, I've taken the liberty of signing Danica up. She's a master of deadpan takedowns and hitting people where it hurts. No one can out-quarrel her, so she'll definitely buy me tons of time. Counting on you, Danica!
Story.About The Captain: I always remember how he looked from behind. So sturdy and reliable, like a steadfast mountain. I never imagined there'd come a day when that mountain would fall. Or at least... I didn't think it would come so soon. He always used to say, "In a real war, you don't get the chance to say goodbye." Of all the ways to prove it to me... Surely, he could have given me one last chance before the end, but he didn't... I'll never let that go, Teach.
Story.About The Jester: Some people skip through the world with a pep in their step, most of them full of hope for what tomorrow will bring. Not him. His steps are always slow and heavy. I always felt that he and my teacher were similar people. I guess it's because they both hide unimaginable sorrow beneath a mask, bearing all the pain of the past on their shoulders.
Story.About The Rooster: Mr. Mayor speaks with such eloquence and composure at the Snezhnograd Veche , and he makes it look so effortless. He can really command the room.
Story.About Regrator: Now, I'm not saying that a Druzhna Commander's salary is low, but it can get a little tight if you're an avid collector who also enjoys treating people to meals... No, oh, no no no, I didn't mean it like that! I wasn't finished. Ever since I can remember, my family's spare funds have been managed by the Northland Bank , and thanks to Mr. Pantalone, the compound returns have grown our wealth quite substantially. Basically, I don't have to worry about money at all. So next time we're out, it's still my treat, and no need to hold back!
Story.About Marionette: Sandrone fully embodies what it means to be a lady. Her words may be highly aggressive in nature, but her impeccable logic makes it impossible to find fault with her... Hehe, it really fascinates me. I must learn how she does it.
Story.About Mitya: Mitya often joins me for hijinks. He's forever sneaking out of the Armory , and the three of us always have a blast! Why "three," you ask? Because there's me, Mitya, and his ever-so-clever scarf.
Story.About Vodyanitsa: Every one of Miss Vodyanitsa's songs is simply beautiful. I love hearing them live. At times they fill me with joy, at other times they move me to tears, just like everyone else in the audience. Sometimes, everyone stays behind after the show ends and suddenly breaks into song together. Well, funnily enough, I just so happen to have a conductor's baton in my hand. And even more funnily, I've noticed on several occasions that Miss Vodyanitsa quietly blends into the crowd after changing out of her stage outfit, puts on a hat, and sings a harmony for the group.
Story.About Odette: I have to be honest — every time I see Miss Odette at a court gathering, I find myself stealing a glance at her constantly. After all, as well as being a member of the Fatui, she has a special alter ego that makes her hard to ignore... Hmm? Why, her role as prima ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe, of course. What did you think I meant?
Story.About Alyosha: I get it, I really do. I mean, how could any little puppy resist the urge to chase a pretty butterfly through the "howling" winds? Hmm... Maybe I'll steal Danica's breakfast and feed it to Tugarin , then ask Alyosha to put in a good word for me, so he doesn't come charging at me the moment he sees me...
Story.More About Vesna: I: Hehe, so how would you like to get to know me? Surely, we're not just going to chat? Well, that's no fun... Hmm... Can't we play a game of "Truth or Dare" instead?
Story.More About Vesna: II: We Druzhna are the Tsaritsa's personal guard, answering directly to Her Majesty. Our duties aren't just limited to neutralizing monster threats and going into battle — they extend beyond military affairs. In all matters concerning Her Majesty's authority and honor, we are bound to answer her call unconditionally and remove all obstacles from her path. However, Her Majesty is inevitably spread a little thin while the grand endeavor against the Heavenly Principles is ongoing. So until the dust has settled, I am more than happy to assist her with the fun stuff— Ahem, I mean, the more trivial matters, such as ribbon-cutting ceremonies and attending banquets on her behalf.
Story.More About Vesna: III: I have an eclectic collection of treasures. Jewelry, ancient books, oil paintings... Anything that makes me happy is worth adding to the collection. And I have to have it the moment I lay eyes upon it, not a single second can be wasted! You know the saying, don't you? "A spoon is dear when lunch time is near." If you wait until after the initial thrill has passed before acquiring it, it loses it appeal. So, if I want it now, I must have it now.
Story.More About Vesna: IV: After Tsar Monomakh 's sacrifice, Snezhnaya went through a period of great turmoil. My forebears stood firmly by the Tsaritsa's side. So, as I stand here on their shoulders today, do I really possess the strength to do justice to their legacy? Hehe, I've put words to the question in your mind, haven't I? Well, now it's your turn to voice the answer that's in mine. Go ahead~
Story.More About Vesna: V: On the eve of the battle against the Ruler of Death , I extracted "Seals of Life" from many people. Everyone's definition of a beautiful memory varies. Some cherish sitting around the fireplace with family, chatting idly. Some fondly remember sitting alone by a train window, watching the aurora drift silently across the night sky. Still others are satisfied simply pulling a sled out for some ice fishing... Those memories are like iridescent bubbles, filled with an effervescence and vitality that just makes you want to exclaim: "Ah, it's so good to be alive!" Yet, those so-called heavenly beings can crush those bubbles with ease, without giving a single word of explanation. What gives them that right? From that moment on, for me, the fight against the Heavenly Principles was no longer solely about assisting Her Majesty.
Story.Vesna's Hobbies: When I was very young, my family arranged for me to take painting, dance, and singing classes. As I got a little older, I took up fencing, horse riding, and the like, hehe... More recently, I've been getting into opera, theater, and collecting my little treasures... In short, the word "bored" doesn't exist in my dictionary.
Story.Vesna's Troubles: Don't listen to Danica's nonsense — there is absolutely nothing wrong with my driving skills. It's called being one with the vehicle! Just wait till my driving ban is lifted. I'll take you for a spin!
Story.Favorite Food: When it's so cold out, there's nothing cozier than gathering everyone together for some nice hot stew! Tell you what — I'll host, and you and Paimon can bring along some cooking ingredients. Anything you like will do~
Story.Least Favorite Food: Hehe! I'm slipping all those annoying veggies onto Danica's plate! Ugh... but they always come right back to me...
Story.Receiving a Gift: I: Oh, don't mind if I do! I'm going to savor every last bite.
Story.Receiving a Gift: II: Mmm... Quite a feat of culinary ingenuity... I think I'll take another bite.
Story.Receiving a Gift: III: Oof... I'm sorry, I already ate! But let me box them up for Danica~
Story.Birthday: Ding-dong! The moment has arrived! You have no idea how hard it was for me to hold it in yesterday... But I had to, because saying it early is bad luck — you might get swallowed up by a snowstorm! Now, I can finally say it: Happy Birthday, my dear friend. May you stand as strong as the birch tree, never defeated by the wind and snow. Alright, that part's done. Next, tradition dictates that I've got to give our birthday superstar a few gentle tugs on the ear...
Story.Feelings About Ascension: Intro: First lesson in boot camp: Only those who do not stand firm and do not yield to the wind and snow are qualified to stand guard by Her Majesty's side.
Story.Feelings About Ascension: Building Up: Second lesson in boot camp: Your sword arm must never tremble.
Story.Feelings About Ascension: Climax: Third lesson in boot camp: We do not weep before our foes.
Story.Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion: You, dear friend, have taught me a lesson from beyond boot camp: To reserve a soft touch with which to embrace those I defend with my sword after the blizzard has died down.

Elemental Skill: (Windborne Sword) More where that came from.
Opening Treasure Chest: Hoho, another piece for my grand collection!
One for you, one for me, one for Her Majesty, and another for me! None for Danica, hehe!
Low HP: A commander stays on the field.
Don't worry, I'll dodge the rest...
Ally at Low HP: Fall back. The Druzhna will take it from here.
Don't push yourself, my dear friend.
Fallen: I'm not in pain... just denial...
Joining Party: I hope you have something fun planned!
